tools.name: vram_fit
tools.description: Will this LoRA config train on a card with vram_gb GB? Returns verdict fits / tight / does_not_fit, the predicted peak in MB, the margin, how each part was derived, and any measured probe with the same settings.

tools.name: vram_max_rank
tools.description: Largest LoRA rank (multiple of 8) that fits with margin on a card with vram_gb GB, and the largest that is tight (a real run may fit, the one-step probe would not).

tools.name: vram_probes
tools.description: The raw measured probe rows (RX 7900 XTX and RTX 3060 Ti), filtered by any of the given settings. gpu matches part of the card name, e.g. '7900' or '3060'.
